method: 只读 text/ 素读，未开 md。抬头：Saturday, June 25, 2044 (Alba is 41)。Alba 第一人称；Humboldt Park 湖畔，夏天午后。

facts.fact: 抬头：2044 年 6 月 25 日星期六，Alba 41 岁。Alba 在 Humboldt Park 的 Boathouse 阴凉处休息，看天鹅脚踏船在潟湖上一圈圈滑过；公园里满是野餐家庭、排球客、遛狗人，还有一场带木偶戏的生日会。她穿的是特大号 Cubs T 恤和宽松牛仔裤，从 Salvation Army 二手店后的垃圾箱捡来；赤脚、饿。她没力气走长路去黄房子（Yellow House），但知道得走：现在出发要两小时，天还不会黑。
facts.quote: It’s a warm, hazy summer afternoon in some not-too-remote future Chicago. I’m resting in the shade at the Boathouse in Humboldt Park, watching the swan pedal boats glide around and around the lagoon.
facts.anchor: Alba: It’s a warm, hazy summer afternoon in some not-too-remote future Chicago

facts.fact: 走了几分钟，有人喊她的名字。她回头看见 Caralora 挥臂招呼，站在一把巨大的橙色遮阳伞旁；Lucinda-Isadora 坐在毯子上的折叠椅里，抱着——一个婴儿。她们在野餐，毯子上摆着 Tupperware、小冷藏箱、盘子和沾着残渣的刀叉。Alba 拥抱 Caralora，亲了 Lucinda-Isadora 泛红的脸颊，问「这是谁？！」她们为她的惊讶而得意。
facts.quote: I’ve only been trudging along for a few minutes when someone calls my name. I turn and see Caralora waving her arms, beckoning, standing next to an enormous orange beach umbrella.
facts.anchor: I’ve only been trudging along for a few minutes when someone calls my name

facts.fact: Caralora 招手让 Alba 坐另一把折叠椅，然后从 Lucinda-Isadora 怀里接过婴儿，小心放进 Alba 臂弯：「This is Voltairine. She’s ten months old.」Voltairine 皱眉端详她的脸；软黑卷发、浅棕皮肤、带金点的宽大淡褐眼睛、两颗小牙。婴儿抓住 Alba 的头发使劲拉，笑了。Alba 说「Ouch」，问「But—how?」
facts.quote: “This is Voltairine,” Caralora says. “She’s ten months old.”
facts.anchor: Caralora motions me into the other lawn chair

facts.fact: Caralora 得意地回答「怎么来的」：「It can be convenient to have an identical twin brother.」（暗示 Caralora 有个同卵双胞胎兄弟，借他完成生育）。Lucinda-Isadora 说婴儿「got my looks and Caralora’s personality」，是「a dangerous combination」。婴儿一听母亲声音就扭身要回去；Alba 把 Voltairine 交还 Lucinda-Isadora，对方铺开小白法兰绒毯、解开胸罩哺乳；说她是「a greedy one」，刚吃完红薯和牛油果。
facts.quote: Caralora looks smug. “It can be convenient to have an identical twin brother.”

facts.fact: Alba 的肚子叫，Caralora 问她要不要吃午饭；Alba 说「You are saving my life」。Caralora 给她盛一盘：炸鸡、土豆沙拉、一小杯西班牙冷汤，甜点是蓝莓派。Caralora 问她「你那边（present）怎么样？」Alba 说「I knew y’all were dating . . .」；Lucinda-Isadora 插话：「We got married a year ago.」并说「我们知道的比你们多，这挺滑稽」。Alba 坚持「Don’t tell me. The less I know, the more free you are.」
facts.quote: “We got married a year ago,” Lucinda-Isadora interjects. “It seems funny, us knowing things you don’t.”
facts.anchor: “So, what’s going on in your present?” Caralora asks.

facts.fact: Caralora 说知情不总是坏事：「It kept me going all these years, knowing what I was waiting for. I didn’t want to be too free.」Alba 问「Did you know exactly?」，Caralora 答「Not exactly… I knew enough. When they came to me, I understood.」Alba 说她们「perfect together」，Voltairine 是幸运的孩子。
facts.quote: “Not exactly,” Caralora says. “I knew enough. When they came to me, I understood.”
facts.anchor: “Did you know exactly?” I ask her

facts.fact: Caralora 说 Voltairine 有五个宠爱她的祖母、三个尽心的姑姨、四个痴迷的叔叔；她不知道 Zach 这么喜欢小孩，他是她们最好的保姆。Alba 说希望 Gomez 能认识她，也希望她爸能。Caralora 说「It’s funny how we just keep living, even after we lose someone irreplaceable.」——她边说边抬头看 Alba，因此没看见 Lucinda-Isadora 脸上掠过的一团悲伤。
facts.quote: “Yeah. It’s funny how we just keep living, even after we lose someone irreplaceable.” Caralora is looking up at me as she speaks, so she doesn’t see the cloud of sadness that passes over Lucinda-Isadora’s face.
facts.anchor: “She is,” Caralora says. “She has five doting grandmas

facts.fact: Caralora 摇着 Voltairine 唱「Twinkle, twinkle, little star」，孩子睡着；公园安静下来，傍晚将至。她们收拾东西，开车送 Alba 去她们在 Logan Boulevard 的公寓；Alba 睡沙发床，醒来时 Voltairine 正咿呀着拍她的脸，她在早餐中途消失，回到 Zach 身边——Zach 想要孩子，将来会是个尽心的小叔叔。她不肯说，只把手指放在唇上：「You’ll find out soon… It’ll be worth the wait, you’ll see.」
facts.quote: We pack up, and they drive me to their home, an apartment on Logan Boulevard, where I sleep on their sofa bed, wake up to Voltairine cooing and patting my face, and vanish in the middle of breakfast, back to Zach, who longs for a child, who will be a devoted uncle.
facts.anchor: Caralora rocks Voltairine and sings to her

turnpoint: 本章的转折点＝Voltairine 的出场与「她怎么来的」那句「同卵双胞胎兄弟」的暗示，加上 Alba 主动拒绝知情（Don’t tell me）——都已进第 3、4、5 条，无需补。
